tests.title: AC-16502-3 (ingest): rcf build finalise on a non-default branch promotes with no flag and no claim C-26 line, and --allow-pre-merge changes nothing

AC-19005-1: on a branch other than main or master whose HEAD contains the report head, rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> exits 0 with no flag, writes verified on the branch and prints the verified-from line, with no "not a default trunk" refusal, no claim C-26 line and nothing but git spawned

AC-19005-1, AC-19005-2 and AC-19005-5 (end to end): a real rcf verify run --hand verifier --url http://127.0.0.1:<port> --engine --served-sha HEAD writes a loopback report naming engine, port and served sha; committed on the feature branch, rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> on that branch promotes it to verified

AC-19005-2: a committed VerifyReport with a loopback target naming target.engine, target.port and target.servedSha equal to its headSha, hand verifier, PASS with ship authority, promotes: exit 0, verified, the verified-from line, no "is loopback"

AC-19005-3: a committed loopback VerifyReport lacking target.engine, target.port or target.servedSha refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: loopback report target <url> names no target.<field>" (first missing in the order engine, port, servedSha), the FBS byte-identical

AC-19005-4: a committed loopback VerifyReport naming target.engine and target.port whose target.servedSha is not its headSha refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: report target.servedSha <served sha7> is not the report head <head sha7>", the FBS byte-identical

AC-19005-5: rcf verify run --hand verifier --url <loopback-url> --engine <name> --served-sha <committed HEAD> records target { kind "url", url, engine, port, servedSha } in rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<head12>.json

AC-19005-5: a --served-sha that is not the full sha of the committed HEAD exits 4 with "verify report refused: --served-sha <value> is not the committed HEAD <sha7>", writing no report and sending no probe

AC-19005-5: a loopback --url with --hand exits 2 with "[error] usage --engine <name> is required with --hand and a loopback --url" with no --engine, and "[error] usage --served-sha <sha> is required with --hand and a loopback --url" with no --served-sha, writing no report and sending no probe

AC-19005-5: outside a --url target (package target mode, --artefact <tgz> or --package <dir>) --engine and --served-sha each exit 2 with "[error] usage --engine applies only to a --url target; package target mode (--artefact <tgz> | --package <dir>) has no served URL" (and the same for --served-sha), with or without --hand, before any pack or install, writing no report

AC-19005-6: a report on disk but not committed in HEAD refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: verify report <path> is not committed at HEAD", and a committed report whose bytes on disk differ refuses exit 4 with "finalise refused: verify report <path> differs from its committed bytes at HEAD", the FBS byte-identical

AC-19005-7: on a branch other than main or master Finalise keeps provenance: a builder Hand-Id equal to verifierId, a report older than --max-report-age and a report head not contained in HEAD each exit 4 with their message, the FBS byte-identical and nothing but git spawned

AC-19005-8: after Finalise writes verified on the branch and the branch merges into main with --no-ff, rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> on main confirms: exit 0, the verified-from line, the FBS byte-identical, a clean tree, nothing but git spawned
AC-19005-8 (end to end): the loopback report verified on the feature branch, merged into main with --no-ff, confirms on main with exit 0 and no write

AC-19005-9: --allow-pre-merge is accepted and changes nothing: the same exit, write and refusal as without it, exactly one deprecation line on stderr, and no output naming claim C-26 or "records the pre-merge decision"

AC-19005-10: rcf build finalise --help, rcf build --help, rcf guidance build-cycle, the playbook (sections 6 and 7), the managed block and the bundle runbook Stage 5 say "on the PR branch before the merge" and name loopback targets with a served sha, and none says "the CI run that passed on the merged head" or puts mark complete or finalise after the merge
